paragraphs.text: The fear of regaining weight after stopping treatment is completely understandable. But weight regain is not a personal failure; when people lose weight, the body triggers natural biological changes that make regain common.
paragraphs.citation: Wilding et al., 2022 · Diabetes Obes Metab

paragraphs.text: In one clinical follow-up trial, participants regained most of their lost weight over one year after stopping treatment, though nearly half still maintained at least 5% weight loss.
paragraphs.citation: Wilding et al., 2022 · Diabetes Obes Metab

paragraphs.text: Sustainable health means accounting for Indian dinner plates, family weddings, and desk jobs. That is why metabolic care requires a planned exit, building long-term habits alongside medical supervision.
Before you start, hear it from a doctor, not a reel. Clinical weight loss, doctor-led. Questions? Ask a Steer doctor. steerclub.com
